title: Step 31: Noncollapsed positive dichotomy spectral and obstruction audit
scope: Conditional theorem for four-dimensional positive noncollapsed branch; not a proof or refutation of Yau-26.

S4_round.note: Conformally flat => W=0, R_+ = (1/3)Id invertible. Ozuch Theorem 0.9: S^4/Z_2 cannot be GH limit of smooth Einstein.

CP2_fubini_study.note: Kähler-Einstein always has W_+ eigenvalue -Lambda/3 on omega^perp. EH desingularization gives Page metric on CP^2 # bar{CP^2}.

H4_hyperbolic.note: Conformally flat => W=0, R_+ = (-1/3)Id invertible. Ozuch Theorem 0.9 applies to H^4/Z_2.

general_kahler_einstein.note: ALL Kähler-Einstein 4-manifolds have det R_+ = 0 at every point. The Kähler direction omega_perp always provides the kernel. This includes CP^2, S^2 x S^2, del Pezzo surfaces, K3, etc.

cross_check.explanation: Both are Kähler-Einstein for the standard orientation. S^2 x S^2 is Kähler via (p,q) -> (p, J_2(q)) where J_2 is the complex structure on S^2 = CP^1.

codimension_analysis.space: Trace-free symmetric 3x3 matrices (= fiber of W_+ bundle)

in_eigenvalue_plane.locus: Union of 3 lines: mu_1=-Lambda/3 OR mu_2=-Lambda/3 OR mu_1+mu_2=Lambda/3
in_eigenvalue_plane.note: Generic positive Einstein 4-manifold has det R_+ != 0 at each point.

codimension_analysis.kahler_exception: Kähler-Einstein manifolds sit ENTIRELY in the zero locus.

annular_flux_scaling.description: Annular flux scaling for obstruction detection
annular_flux_scaling.strategy: Fix K (annular ratio), let delta->0, then K->infty
annular_flux_scaling.conclusion: For fixed K and sufficiently small delta, bulk error is negligible compared to signal. Detection requires delta << t^4 / R^6, always achievable.

remark_0_6.general_einstein: Nontrivial algebraic condition on orbifold Weyl at p

corollary_4_11.statement: First obstruction vanishes => orbifold is NOT spherical/hyperbolic
corollary_4_11.contrapositive: Spherical/hyperbolic orbifold => first obstruction nonzero => no EH desingularization (or any Ricci-flat ALE desingularization)

ozuch_obstruction_verification.remark_0_7: Higher-order obstructions exist for Einstein deformations g_t = g + t*h_1 + t^2*h_2 + ...
ozuch_obstruction_verification.question_0_8: Can higher-order Taub/Pohozaev obstructions recover [Ozu20] obstructions? OPEN.
ozuch_obstruction_verification.implication_for_yau26: The contrapositive direction is most valuable: if the orbifold limit has det R_+ != 0 at all singular points, no EH bubbling can occur, forcing the regular alternative (Einstein on M). For non-Kähler generic positive Einstein orbifolds, this is the expected situation.

dichotomy_theorem.theorem_statement: Let (M^4, g_i) with ||Ric_{g_i} - g_i||_op <= delta_i -> 0 and Vol(M, g_i) >= v0 > 0. Then either: (A) M carries a smooth Einstein metric h with Ric_h = h [for large i], or (B) A subsequence converges to an Einstein orbifold (M_infty, g_infty) with Ric = g_infty, finitely many isolated singularities, and at each Z_2 singular point: W_+^{g_infty}(p) has eigenvalue -1/3, i.e., det R_+(p) = 0.

ingredients: Bishop-Gromov + volume lower bound => local noncollapse
Cheeger-Naber: C^{1,alpha} cap W^{2,q} convergence off codim-4 set
If singular set empty: weak limit satisfies Ric=g, elliptic regularity => smooth
Cheeger-Gromov diffeomorphism recovery => Einstein on original M

assumptions: A1: Bubble-tree existence and finiteness for near-Einstein sequences (follows from CGB L^2-curvature budget in 4D: each EH bubble carries 12pi^2)
A2: The annular flux of the divergence-free cosmological Einstein tensor converges to the exact Ozuch boundary integral in the double limit (delta->0 first, then annular ratio K->infty)
A3: The first Ozuch obstruction for the exact limit (orbifold + ALE) must be satisfied
case_B_proof.note: A2 is the core mathematical content to be established. The scaling argument suggests it holds but rigorous proof requires annular C^{1,alpha} control sufficient to make L_Z g close to L_Z g_infty.

dichotomy_theorem.exclusion_corollary: If the orbifold limit has det R_+(p) != 0 at every potential singular point, then case (B) is impossible, so case (A) holds: M carries an Einstein metric. For conformally flat orbifold limits (W=0, including spherical/hyperbolic), this is automatic (Ozuch Theorem 0.9).
what_this_does_NOT_do: Does not handle collapsed positive branch (Route B)
Does not handle negative branch or n >= 5
In case (B), does not produce Einstein metric on M
Does not address higher-order obstructions (Ozuch Question 0.8)
Does not address multiple bubbles, bubble trees, or ALE type selection

key_spectral_result.statement: For positive Einstein Ric = g in dimension 4, R_+ = W_+ + (1/3)*Id on Lambda^2_+. det R_+ = 0 iff W_+ has eigenvalue -1/3.
key_spectral_result.conformally_flat_case: W=0 => R_+ = (1/3)Id, det = 1/27 != 0. No EH desingularization. Applies to S^4, H^4.
key_spectral_result.kahler_einstein_case: W_+ always has eigenvalue -Lambda/3 => det R_+ = 0 always. EH compatible. Applies to CP^2, S^2xS^2, del Pezzo, K3.
key_spectral_result.generic_non_kahler_case: det R_+ != 0 is codimension-1 open condition. Expected to hold generically for non-Kähler orbifolds.
key_spectral_result.dichotomy_consequence: Under noncollapsing, if orbifold limit is non-Kähler generic (det R_+ != 0 everywhere), then no EH bubbling => Einstein on original M.

strategic_implications: 1. The noncollapsed positive dichotomy gives Einstein existence on M whenever the orbifold limit is 'generic enough' (non-Kähler, no special W_+ eigenvalue).
2. The obstruction excludes bubbling (contrapositive), not enables gluing. This avoids the entire higher-order obstruction problem.
3. Spherical/hyperbolic orbifold limits automatically give Einstein on M (Ozuch Thm 0.9 mechanism).
4. Kähler-Einstein orbifold limits are the hard case: det R_+ = 0 everywhere, so the first obstruction does not exclude bubbling.
5. For #_k(S^2 x S^2) stress family: orbifold limit (if noncollapsed) would need det R_+ = 0 at each singular point. With k bubbles and Weyl energy ~ k, this constrains the Weyl distribution.
6. The annular flux argument is the main open mathematical obligation. Its proof requires C^{1,alpha} annular control from Cheeger-Naber.
